item.title: Nice landscaping and curb appeal! Circa 1945 in Illinois. $399,900
item.description: This house has professional landscaping and a lot of nice curb appeal! The house was built in 1945. It is located on .38 acre in Melrose Park, Illinois. The house features wood floors, wood burning fireplace, two kitchens, unique staircase, baseboards and updated bathrooms. There is a detached garage on the property. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 1,700 square feet. $399,900 Contact Patrizia Vicari with Skyward Realty: 847-606-7079 From the Zillow listing: Fabulous curb appeal on this lovel

item.title: Love the bookcases and the pool! Circa 1890 in Indiana. $350,000
item.description: Love those bookcases! And the pool was a nice surprise! The house was built in 1890. It is located on .27 acre in Terre Haute, Indiana. The house features nice curb appeal, large stone chimney, covered side porch, wood floors, pretty fireplace, crown moulding, wide baseboards, amazing bookcases, updated kitchen and a vintage bathroom. The backyard has a beautiful in-ground pool. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,926 square feet. $350,000 Contact Joe Everhart with Everhart Studio From the Zil

item.title: In love!! Great details inside! Almost five acres in Virginia. $489,000
item.description: I am in love with this house and property! There are eight outbuildings! Love the interior details! The house was built in 1800. It is located on 4.84 acres in Buchanan, Virginia. The house features a large covered front porch, wood floors, log walls, great stove, pretty kitchen sink, loft area, stone fireplaces, beautiful tub and exposed beams. There are nice outbuildings and pretty scenery! Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,553 square feet. $489,000 Contact Judy Hillman with Long and Foster Roa

item.title: Beautiful! Nice event barn! Over an acre in Virginia. $497,000
item.description: This is a beautifully maintained house! Some select furnishings will convey with the house. Love the interior of that event barn! The house was built in the early 1800’s. It is located on 1.398 acres in Charlotte Court House, Virginia. The house features a beautiful setting, pond with gazebo, event barn, wood floors, leaded glass, crown moulding, wainscoting, chair rails and built-ins. Love the turned staircase. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,102 square feet. $497,000 Contact the property

item.title: Beautiful staircase! Pretty floors! C. 1861 in Kansas. $269,900
item.description: This house has a beautiful staircase! Love some of the floors too! The house was built in 1861. It is located on .20 acre in Leavenworth, Kansas. The house features a grand staircase, some original wood floors, inlaid wood floors, wainscoting, ceiling medallions, baseboards, pocket doors, transom windows and a claw foot tub. There is a detached carriage house on the property. Five bedrooms, three bathrooms and 4,176 square feet. $269,900 Contact Quinn Whimley with Reilly Real Estate: 913-683-313

item.title: This has character! Shotgun style house. Circa 1854 in Louisiana. $235,000
item.description: This house has character! Some color inside would enhance it! This shotgun style house was built in 1854. It is located in Gretna, Louisiana. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, wide baseboards, transom windows, exposed brick, picture rails and crown moulding. Out back there is a large deck and a patio. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,198 square feet. $235,000 Contact Glennda Bach with Compass Uptown with 504-583-2792 From the Zillow listing: Step into timeless charm with th

item.title: Almost three acres in Maine. Would love to see this in the summer! $128,500
item.description: This isn’t a bad house! Would love to see it in the summer! The house was built in 1880. It is located on 2.95 acres in Presque Isle, Maine. The house features a partially enclosed porch, some wood floors, nice staircase and built-ins. The river is on the back of the property. Four bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,368 square feet. $128,500 Contact Progressive Realty From the Zillow listing: Charming farmhouse set on 2.95 scenic acres with an impressive 475 feet of frontage along the Aroostook River.

item.title: Island time! Private island in Maine with a rustic cabin! Seals visit the island! $259,000
item.description: Island time! This would be fun to own! The only inhabitants are seals and bald eagles! Little Dochet Island has a rustic cabin that was built in 1900. The island is 1.25 acres in Robbinston, Maine. The island is near the Canadian coastline and has access to Passamaquoddy Bay and the ocean. The rustic cabin has new siding and new windows. The island is a five minute boat ride from the mainland. The cabin is 350 square feet. $259,000 Contact Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Northeast Real Estate Fr

item.title: Diamond in the Rough! Circa 1935 in North Carolina. $170,000
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough to me! It has a lot of potential! If it were me, I would undo a lot of the trendy DIY renovations. The house was built in 1935. It is located on .7 acres in Fremont, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, pretty front door with leaded glass sidelights and transom, wood floors, baseboards, chair rails and crown moulding. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,238 square feet. $170,000 Contact Michael Ellis with Coldwell Banker Howard Pe

item.title: Nice kitchen! Great porch! Two acres in North Carolina. $305,000
item.description: I like the kitchen in this house! Great porch too! I wish they showed inside the brick building on the property. The house was built in 1910. It is located on 2.06 acres in Littleton, North Carolina. The house features a large wrap around front porch, nice brick retaining wall, spacious kitchen, wood floors, crown moulding, built-in bookshelves, baseboards and a finished third floor.
